text: The service, communication, and handling of the damage to the customer's tooth were terrible. Ultimately, they shifted the blame to the customer and offered a half-hearted solution, resulting in the same problem as before. Teeth are a crucial part of one's appearance; don't risk going to a clinic like this. I didn't want to argue further, so I opted to pay extra to another clinic for further treatment. It was just a simple filling, and it shouldn't have escalated into such a problem. I lost a beautiful tooth, wasted time, and felt terrible. I don't understand how they can run a clinic with such awful attitude and service. Truly terrible.
